name: Generate structured image prompts for visual concepts
description: Users asked the assistant to generate four distinct image prompts for a generative AI tool based on specific visual concepts such as product packaging, interior design, and event posters. They provided strict formatting guidelines, including required parameters like aspect ratio and version, while often varying the environmental details, composition, and style across the generated prompts.
